scenes.tts: You need ten to twenty ordinary mealworms, a clear plastic tub with a lid, and rolled oats or wheat bran.
scenes.narration: You need ten to twenty ordinary mealworms, a clear plastic tub with a lid, and rolled oats or wheat bran.

scenes.tts: An adult pokes ten to twenty small holes in the lid. Spread oats or bran three to five centimetres deep. Lay two thin slices of carrot or potato on top. Spoon the mealworms in.

items.text: Two thin carrot or potato slices

scenes.narration: An adult pokes ten to twenty small holes in the lid. Spread oats or bran three to five centimetres deep. Lay two thin slices of carrot or potato on top. Spoon the mealworms in.

scenes.tts: Look for shed skins two or three times a week. The first pupae often appear within a few weeks. A beetle comes out after about one to three weeks as a pupa.

scenes.tts: Mealworms can cause allergy and asthma symptoms. If your child has asthma or a shellfish or dust mite allergy, ask their doctor first, and skip it if in doubt.
